subject: EdgeConf sponsorship: creative brief + technical one-pager
messages:
From: Maya Brooks <maya@edgeconf.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sponsorships Team <sponsorships@edgeconf.co>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Sponsorship creative + tech one-pager for EdgeConf booth

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for committing to be a sponsor at EdgeConf (Sept 28-30). We run a short sponsor spotlight in the program and we also create a sponsor guide that goes to registrants and prospective attendees.

Can you send over: 1) a concise one-pager (one sheet) focused on product benefits and use-cases for platform/engineering audiences, and 2) a technical one-pager that covers integration highlights (deployment modes, security bullets, hardware/latency expectations) that we can hand to SRE/Platform teams who visit booths?

Deadline: we need print-ready PDFs and a web-friendly version by Aug 12 to make the program and the exhibitor kit. If you have a preferred logo lockup and brand color hex, please include.

Also: will you be running a 10–12 minute live demo on the show floor? If yes, provide a short demo script and the AV requirements (internet vs local demo, laptop spec, mic). We can provide a table for AV requests.

Appreciate it — attach files to this thread or share a Drive link.

Best,
Maya Brooks
Partnerships Lead, EdgeConf

[Attachment stubs: edgeconf_asset_request_form.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Brooks <maya@edgeconf.co>
Cc: Sponsorships Team <sponsorships@edgeconf.co>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsorship creative + tech one-pager for EdgeConf booth

Hi Maya —

Thanks — we can deliver both docs by Aug 10 to give you extra time for print. Attaching drafts; see quick notes below.

Attachments: Redwood_OnePager_EdgeConf_v1.pdf (PDF), Redwood_Technical-OnePager_EdgeConf_v1.pdf (PDF)

Quick summary:
- One-pager (audience: product & engineering buyers): short value bullets, 3 quick case highlights (retail, fintech, regulated data), CTA to schedule a post-show deep dive.
- Technical one-pager (audience: SRE/Platform): deployment modes (Hosted API, Dedicated pools, Private VPC/on-prem), basic perf numbers (95th pct latency @ 512 tokens on p4d-like hardware), security & compliance bullets (SOC 2, VPC peering, KMS), sample integration diagram (link in Drive).

Live demo: yes — we'll do two 5-minute scenarios back-to-back (customer intent routing + API cold-start vs warmed cache). We prefer a local laptop + wired ethernet. AV ask: 1x HDMI, wired internet recommended, lav mic. Laptop: MacBook Pro M1/M2 class is fine; we can bring a small Ubuntu laptop and pre-load the demo container if requested.

Next steps (internal): Ava, can you give copy edits and confirm the case highlights are ok for public use? Karthik — can you confirm the perf numbers and that the hardware description is accurate?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

[Signature]

Folks — reviewed copy. A few small edits inline; suggested timeline and action items: 
- Karthik: confirm the 95th pct latency figure and any qualification text we should add about token length and quantization. If we can't lock that number publicly, we should use ranges (e.g., ~60-120ms) and flag that exact numbers depend on model/seq length.
- Soojin: request logo assets (SVG and white/colored lockups) from EdgeConf contact and ask about preferred brand color for the program PDF.
- I'll tighten the customer bullets to be benefits-first (less jargon).

Also: for the live demo, recommend we prepare a fallback video recording in case network/AV fails. We should bring both a local container (offline) and a short pre-rendered 90s clip to play.

Ava Chen
Senior Field Marketer, Redwood Inference

[Inline edits applied to Drive files: https://drive.google.com/redwood/EdgeConf/CreativeBrief]

Hi Soojin & team —

Perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear AV notes. I have attached the logo guidelines and the sponsor program color palette. Printing deadline confirmed: Aug 12 (we'll accept the Aug 10 draft for review).

A few small asks:
- Can the technical one-pager include a short "what to expect at the booth" note for SREs (how long the demo runs, whether they can test with a sample data set, confidentiality notice)?
- Please include a single-line privacy blurb about logs/telemetry and that no customer data will be retained in demo mode.

We'll add you to the exhibitor portal. Sending logo pack now.

Best,
Maya Brooks
Partnerships Lead, EdgeConf
